newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PM says half of fcast 97 GDP growth a success.
newsitem.headline: Czech PM says half of fcast 97 GDP growth a success.

text.p: Czech Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus said on Wednesday that he would consider 1997 GDP growth of half the forecast 5.4 percent, year-on-year, as a success.
"It would be a success if growth reached half of this (estimate)," he told a news conference outlining a series of measures aimed at helping the country's limping economy.
